sections.content: 4.1 Properties of Materials 4.1.1 Malleability Activity 4.1: Let us explore Caution— Conduct this activity under the supervision of your teacher or an adult. Collect some waste pieces of copper and aluminium, an iron nail, a piece of coal, a pea-sized lump of sulfur (gandhak), and a block of wood. Recall the chapter ‘Materials Around Us’ in the Grade 6 Science textbook Curiosity and observe the appearances of the above items.
